name: Architecture (OpenUP Capability Pattern)
description: EPF/OpenUP's Architecture capability pattern, modelled as a Pack: the Architect role, the Architecture Notebook work product, and the tasks for designing and validating the solution structure.

capabilities.name: Architecture Design
capabilities.description: Designs the technical solution structure and key design decisions on behalf of the Architect role.

services.name: Architecture Notebook
services.contractDescription: The candidate architecture, key design decisions, and rationale — sufficient to guide implementation.

items.statement: The solution has been decomposed into design elements consistent with the requirements and constraints.
Feedback from Development and Test on the architecture's feasibility has been incorporated.

reviewGates.name: Architecture Notebook Review
reviewGates.statement: The Architecture Notebook has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to guide implementation.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the architecture sufficiently detailed, consistent, and approved to guide implementation?
